# 2FA-vlv v1.0.0

First public release.

- Live TOTP codes with countdown ring; HOTP and Steam Guard; SHA1/SHA256/SHA512; 4-10 digits.
- Import LastPass Authenticator JSON backups (folders and favorites kept, duplicates skipped).
- Add accounts manually, by `otpauth://` link, from a QR image or a screen capture.
- Favorites, folders, drag-and-drop order, search, colored service badges.
- Optional: Keychain storage, Touch ID / password lock, auto-lock, hidden codes, clipboard auto-clear, menu bar popover, global shortcut `⌃⌥⌘2`, launch at login.
- English interface with a Spanish switch (🇺🇸 / 🇲🇽).
- About screen with GitHub and SourceForge links.

Ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Right-click → Open on first launch.
